NewsArticle.Title: Web page survey
NewsArticle.Content: Due to a technical glitch, the survey sent out on Tuesday, 5/15 is currently not working properly. However, some of the surveys have already been answered. We ask that you answer the first question with the top four areas that you find the most important to the game, in the order you find their importance, and leave the remaining ones blank. We apologize for the inconvience and will create a new survey for next month with greater details of questions.
